title_en: speciesOT E1 · Four verbs and a contract
title_zh: speciesOT 第一集 · 四个动词和一份契约
description_en: How to read speciesot_core.py: every class does one of five jobs. Classes, objects, init and self; abstract classes as contracts that check names, not inputs; the Experiment that conducts models and metrics. For a researcher who has never designed a Python package.
description_zh: 怎样读懂 speciesot_core.py：每个类都属于五种分工之一。类、对象、init 与 self；抽象类是只检查名字、不检查参数的契约；由 Experiment 指挥模型和指标。献给从没设计过 Python 包的研究者。
production_notes: Code shown on screen is Josh's speciesot_core.py as attached on 2026-10-14 (sha256 in SOURCES.md); line numbers refer to that file. Never invent lines that are not in it.

The TypeError text in s03 is MEASURED with Python 3.12 (videos/speciesot-series/checks/error_trail.json, stage 'abstract'); show it verbatim and tag it 'Python 3.12' (3.9-3.11 word it 'with abstract methods ...').
Spoken forms: init (never 'underscore underscore'); 'self.lr' and 'model.predict' are voiced through the lexicon; line numbers are spoken as numbers.
Keep the five-jobs vocabulary identical across scenes: data, contract, conductor, model, metric.
Python's ABC check is by method NAME at construction time, never by signature: say so in s06 (IdentityModel.train(self) vs the contract's train(self, training_data) is the E5 Liskov example).
s01 shows e24_src_example.ipynb (repo root of the speciesOT repo, cell 1): the four calls are written there but that cell has no recorded execution; say 'writes', not 'runs'.

lines.en: Here is a whole research experiment, as Josh's example notebook writes it. Four calls: set up, train, predict, evaluate.
lines.zh: 这是 Josh 在示例 notebook 里写下的一整个科研实验。只有四个调用：setup、train、predict、evaluate。

lines.en: Behind them sits one file, speciesot_core.py, about three hundred and fifty lines long. Which lines matter, and where do you even start reading?
lines.zh: 它们背后是一个文件：speciesot_core.py，大约三百五十行。哪些行重要？到底该从哪里读起？

lines.en: Here's the trick: every class in that file does one of five jobs. Data, contract, conductor, model, and metric. Let's learn to see them.
lines.zh: 诀窍是：这个文件里的每一个类，都属于五种分工之一——数据、契约、指挥、模型、指标。我们来学会看出它们。

lines.en: Start with the word you'll see most: class. A class is a blueprint. It describes what a thing will know and what it can do, but it isn't the thing itself.
lines.zh: 先从出现最多的词开始：class，类。类是一张蓝图：它描述一个东西会知道什么、能做什么，但它本身还不是那个东西。

lines.en: Calling a class like a function builds an object from it. Line 115 does exactly that: scGenModel, given its slice of the config.
lines.zh: 像调用函数一样调用一个类，就会按蓝图造出一个对象。第 115 行正是这么做的：scGenModel，传入属于它的那一段配置。

lines.en: The moment the object is built, Python runs its init method. Each line of init writes one fact onto the new object: the learning rate, the latent size, where to save the model.
lines.zh: 对象一造好，Python 就会运行它的 init 方法。init 的每一行都往新对象身上写一个事实：学习率、潜空间大小、模型保存在哪里。

lines.en: And self just means this particular object. self.lr is this model's learning rate. Build two models, and each one keeps its own.
lines.zh: self 的意思就是「这个对象自己」。self.lr 就是这个模型自己的学习率。造两个模型，它们各自保存各自的。

lines.en: Near the top of the file is a different kind of class: AbstractModel. Every method is marked abstract, and its body only raises an error.
lines.zh: 文件开头附近有一种不一样的类：AbstractModel。它的每个方法都标着 abstract（抽象），方法体里只会抛出错误。

lines.en: It's a contract. Anything that calls itself a model must know how to set up, train, and predict. The contract names the methods. It doesn't fill them in.
lines.zh: 这是一份契约：任何自称「模型」的东西，都必须会 setup、train 和 predict。契约只写下方法的名字，不负责填写内容。

lines.en: Pause and predict: what happens if you try to build an AbstractModel directly?
lines.zh: 停下来猜一猜：如果直接去造一个 AbstractModel，会发生什么？

lines.en: Python refuses. We ran it: can't instantiate abstract class AbstractModel without an implementation for predict, setup and train.
lines.zh: Python 会拒绝。我们实际跑过：无法实例化抽象类 AbstractModel，因为 predict、setup、train 都还没有实现。

lines.en: IdentityModel and scGenModel fill in the blanks. Writing AbstractModel in parentheses after the class name is how they sign the contract. That's called inheritance.
lines.zh: IdentityModel 和 scGenModel 把空白填上了。在类名后面的圆括号里写上 AbstractModel，就是它们签下契约的方式。这叫继承。

lines.en: You'll also see abc.ABC on Experiment and the data classes. With no abstract methods, there's nothing to sign. Josh's note on line 19 says it can go.
lines.zh: 你还会在 Experiment 和数据类上看到 abc.ABC。它们没有抽象方法，也就没有要签的条款。Josh 第 19 行的注释也说可以去掉。

lines.en: The Experiment class is the conductor. It never does the science itself. It reads the config, builds the pieces, and tells each one when to play.
lines.zh: Experiment 类是指挥。它自己从不做科学计算：它读配置、造出各个部件，再告诉每个部件何时上场。

lines.en: Setup fills two lists: models, from the models section of config.yaml, and evaluations, from the evaluations section.
lines.zh: setup 会填好两个列表：models 来自 config.yaml 的 models 部分，evaluations 来自 evaluations 部分。

lines.en: Train and predict walk down the models list. Predict collects one answer from each model: a set of predicted human cells.
lines.zh: train 和 predict 沿着 models 列表逐个执行。predict 从每个模型收集一个答案：一组预测出的人类细胞。

lines.en: Evaluate crosses the two lists. Two models times two metrics: four numbers.
lines.zh: evaluate 把两个列表交叉起来：两个模型乘以两个指标，得到四个数字。

lines.en: One honest detail: as written, evaluate computes those numbers and then drops them. Line 145 never stores them. Remember that for episode five.
lines.zh: 说一个实情：按现在的写法，evaluate 算出这些数字后就把它们丢掉了，第 145 行没有存下来。第五集会回到这一点。

lines.en: Here's the payoff. Line 137 calls model.predict, without ever asking which model it's talking to.
lines.zh: 回报在这里：第 137 行调用 model.predict，却从不过问自己在和哪个模型说话。

lines.en: IdentityModel answers by handing back the mouse cells unchanged. It's the do-nothing baseline: a real model has to beat simply copying the mouse.
lines.zh: IdentityModel 的回答是原封不动地交回小鼠细胞。它是「什么都不做」的基线：真正的模型至少要胜过直接照抄小鼠。

lines.en: scGenModel will answer by shifting the mouse cells toward human. Same question, different answers. That's polymorphism.
lines.zh: scGenModel 则会把小鼠细胞往人类方向平移。同一个问题，不同的回答——这就是多态。

lines.en: So think about it: when you add CellOT as a third model, which lines of the Experiment should have to change?
lines.zh: 那么想一想：当你把 CellOT 加进来作为第三个模型时，Experiment 里有哪些行应该改动？

lines.en: Ideally, none. Today, setup still names each model by hand, in a chain of if statements. Episode five pulls on that thread.
lines.zh: 理想情况是一行都不用改。但目前 setup 里还用一串 if 语句逐个点名模型。第五集会顺着这根线往下拉。

lines.en: Recap. A class is a blueprint, and an object is built from it. Init writes the object's facts, and self means this one.
lines.zh: 回顾一下。类是蓝图，对象按蓝图造出来。init 写下对象的事实，self 指的就是它自己。

lines.en: An abstract class is a contract. It names the methods, and Python won't build a model until every named method is filled in. It checks names, not inputs. Episode five shows what slips through.
lines.zh: 抽象类是一份契约：它写下方法名，在每个方法都填好之前，Python 不会造出这个模型。但它只检查名字，不检查参数——第五集会看到漏过去的是什么。

lines.en: The Experiment conducts, and models and metrics plug into it through their contracts.
lines.zh: Experiment 负责指挥，模型和指标通过各自的契约接进来。

lines.en: Your turn: open speciesot_core.py and label every class with one of the five jobs. The line numbers are in the companion notes.
lines.zh: 轮到你了：打开 speciesot_core.py，给每个类标上五种分工之一。具体行号写在配套笔记里。
